findings.title: Palestinian killed and others injured in Israeli drone strike near Muawiya Mosque in al-Mawasi, Rafah
findings.location: Near Muawiya Mosque, al-Mawasi, west of Rafah, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Palestinian people near the reported drone strike; one death and multiple injuries reported by WAFA; individual civilian/combatant classifications not independently established
findings.exact_supporting_passage: WAFA correspondent reported that an Israeli drone struck an area near Muawiya Mosque in al-Mawasi, west of Rafah, killing a Palestinian and injuring several others.
findings.source_type: On-scene/local correspondent reporting by Palestinian public news agency; additional Palestinian local media reporting with conflicting toll
findings.confidence: medium-high for occurrence/location and at least one death; medium for precise casualty count
findings.summary: WAFA English and Arabic on 15 November report at least one person killed and several injured by a drone near Muawiya Mosque in al-Mawasi, Rafah. Khabar Press and SadaNews separately report two killed, while PalSawa and WAFA report one, so exact death count is unresolved. Do not add the differing source tallies or merge this Sunday evening Rafah incident with the Saturday al-Mawasi Khan Younis strike that killed Hamas Rafah brigade commander Samir Abu Younis.

bounded_discovery_context.caution: No independent verified casualty list, named civilian identification or precise strike time available. Sources may rely on shared informants; avoid asserting independent confirmations or two confirmed deaths.

findings.location: Al-Satr al-Gharbi, northwest of Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip

findings.source_type: Palestinian public news agency report in Arabic; separate incident mentioned in concurrent Rafah strike dispatch

This item is absent from the English-language version of the accompanying Rafah article, and no further details or independent source confirmation were found. Do not attribute this injury to the Rafah drone strike.

bounded_discovery_context.verification_limit: Corroborative details, victim identity, precise incident time and civilian status were not established.

findings.title: Egyptian Red Crescent says 312th Gaza aid convoy dispatched with 2,759 tonnes including 602 tonnes of fuel
findings.publisher: Ahram Online, citing Egyptian Red Crescent statement
findings.location: Egypt; convoy dispatched for Gaza (crossing/arrival into Gaza unverified)
findings.affected_population_system: Humanitarian relief and food supply for displaced Palestinians; hospitals, bakeries and other essential services targeted by fuel assistance
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The Egyptian Red Crescent (ERC) dispatched its 312th Gaza aid convoy on Sunday, carrying 2,759 tonnes of food, relief, medical and winter supplies
findings.source_type: Established Egyptian news publication quoting Egyptian Red Crescent statement; original ERC statement not independently retrieved
findings.summary: Ahram Online reports that Egypt's Red Crescent dispatched a Gaza-bound convoy with more than 2,020 tonnes of flour and food baskets, 137 tonnes of relief supplies and medicines and 602 tonnes of fuel, plus tents and warm clothing. Dispatch is NOT proof that goods or fuel crossed into or were distributed inside Gaza. Original publication clock time and delivery/entry status are unverified.

bounded_discovery_context.caution: Reported Egyptian dispatch, not verified Gaza entry, humanitarian transfer or actual functioning-capacity restoration. May predate prior cutoff; previous heartbeat did not mention convoy.
